title: Quality Assurance Engineer

Design and automate robust data pipelines and analytical workflows for large-scale engineering data. Experience 4+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, optimization, or related technical fields. Technical Skills Strong foundation in statistics, machine learning, deep learning, and the mathematical foundations of AI/ML algorithms. Hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, NLP, embeddings, RAG, information retrieval, and AI agents. Experience developing agentic AI workflows and multi-agent systems, including orchestration, tool integration, and scalable AI applications. Strong knowledge of mathematical and combinatorial optimization, constraint optimization, pathfinding, graph search, heuristic methods, and reinforcement learning. Keep up-to-date knowledge of portfolio products, applications and OT/IoT devices, and their architecture, dependencies and normal behaviour. Availability and Performance Monitor the health of portfolio products daily (availability, performance and capacity) and act on warning signs before they become incidents. Act as technical expert for incidents and war rooms involving portfolio products, working with Incident Commanders and Major Incident Managers. Run a monthly service review for each portfolio product covering availability, performance, incidents, problems, risks and upcoming changes. Deliver assigned problem fixes, and draft known-error entries and workarounds. Build operational best practices, and feed lessons from problems into design reviews and readiness checklists so they don't recur. Diagnose problems that span several technologies across network, operating system, cloud, application and database layers. Supply runbooks, product knowledge articles and known-error articles to NOC, SOC and the service desk. Identify automation opportunities and define what healthy looks like for products, working with the automation pod and the observability team. Take on additional design-to-support responsibilities for NOC-run services as defined by the NOC Senior Manager.
